The signature is VocaColle\'s, so App Check can issue tokens. A login error here comes from the account, the network, or the server.

The app is re-signed, so Firebase App Check (Play Integrity) can\'t issue a token, and login and guest login fail with WL-E08. No patch can fix this: install with VocaColle\'s original signature kept (for example with CorePatch on a rooted device), or use a Reseam mount build over the installed app.
